reviews.text: We've been working with Irene for many months, and she's managed to help us find our Border Collie, a mission that seemed impossible to me at first. It was very hard, but with effort and dedication, it's been worth it. I can't thank you enough for what you've done for this family!
Very unprofessional and the owner Carlos is a very arrogant man; I was very disappointed.
I don't recommend it. I don't know what the owner, Carlos, has done to my dog, but he's become more aggressive, and he seemed to have very poor manners.
Terrible. I met the owner, a guy named Carlos, and he couldn't have treated me worse. I don't recommend him.

We've been working with Irene for several months now, and both we and our dog have learned a lot. She's helped us with Coco's training for walks in the city and the countryside, house training, and so on. Everything has gone very well, and we're quite happy.

Completely unprofessional, I absolutely do not recommend them. I contacted Dos Adiestramiento Valencia because of a problem with my dog. A guy (Gerardo) answered and told me he would call me back because he was with a client. A year has passed, and I'm still waiting for him to call. I've now contacted Dog's Eden Training, and they solved my problem. I saw results from the very first visit. They are super professional and very friendly. Don't call Dos Adiestramiento; they are completely unprofessional. I'm posting this review here because there's no option to leave reviews on their Valencia page. You don't need to call me anymore.

I'd like to highlight the professionalism of Irene, the trainer who worked with my dogs. She was a great help in correcting their behavior when I went to work. I highly recommend her. Thank you so much!

I've had classes with Irene, and we've managed to get our podenco to stop barking at everyone. Now we can walk peacefully and even sit on a bench without the dog experiencing fears that lead to unwanted behaviors.

She helped us understand our dog's situation and gave us respectful guidelines, addressing the root causes of the problems rather than simply reacting to the animal's behavior.

She provided us with strategies and tools that have worked in her experience, while remaining flexible about things that didn't work for our dog.
The Dos Adiestramiento team is highly professional, as well as friendly and approachable. They not only help the dogs, but also their humans.
I was delighted.

We met with Irene. She was wonderful; we're thrilled. We have a very reactive and possessive Chihuahua-Pomeranian mix, Nina. With Irene's help, we've managed to significantly improve our walks, which were a nightmare. We were also concerned about Nina's behavior with our newborn, who is now 19 months old, and we wanted to learn how to manage their coexistence. Thanks to Irene's work and her help, we've achieved our goals. We're still in contact with her. Highly recommended; we're very grateful.

Two training sessions have helped me a lot with my dog.
Carlos has given me advice and strategies to help my dog ​​be gentle and well-balanced.
THANK YOU, Carlos!! We highly recommend you!!

We've used Dos Adiestramiento several times.

The first time was when Joy came into our lives.
At that time, we attended a super interesting and useful seminar that helped us understand Joy as a puppy. Carlos gave us some really helpful tips that helped us understand our dog at each stage of her development.
A few days ago, we contacted Carlos for help with a temperament issue. He was incredibly accommodating and met with us on a Sunday.
Today, we've been putting his advice into practice for a week now and we're thrilled to see how effective it is. We've seen results from day one.

Thank you, Carlos and team, for your professionalism, your advice, and the help you offer to make our dogs amazing.

I adopted a little dog who was two years old and contacted Laia because she was my first dog and everything was new to me. I want to thank DOS Adiestramiento Camino and especially Laia for making canine life easier. She helped us and is still a part of my life today. Put a Laia in your life! I recommend them a thousand times over. THANK YOU IN CAPITALS.

I contacted Dos Adiestramientos with a question about my puppy and the loss of my older dog, and Carlos was incredibly kind and attentive. He gave me some great advice that I will definitely follow. Thank you so much for everything, and my recommendation: 10/10

I contacted Dos because I was having problems with my puppy. She was a very active puppy, and I needed help managing walks and her energy at home. Working with Irene has been fantastic. From day one, she identified the problems and I was able to make changes to improve the situation. She taught me guidelines for walks, how to set boundaries, establish a routine, and how to get my dog ​​to be calmer. We've solved problems like pulling, barking, and accidents inside. We're still working on it, but my puppy is much happier, and so am I.

We contacted the company because our dogs weren't learning proper house training, and Irene was a great help in correcting this by thoroughly reviewing the dogs' routines. We're very happy with the results.

We've had three sessions with Irene and we're very happy with the results.
Irene hasn't just focused on the problem we were having with our dog; she's investigated all aspects of the dog's life, starting with her life at home (something a previous trainer we had never done). This has led to many discoveries, and the dog has changed a lot. We'll continue working with her guidelines because there's no magic bullet in the dog world. I would definitely recommend Irene again.
Great! Irene is very clear and direct, and following her advice to the letter gives excellent results. I'm very happy with her.
Irene is a great professional, knowledgeable about dog psychology, we have been very happy with her and she has helped us a lot.
Thanks, Irene, for your advice. I needed it more than the little dog did.

We've had a few minor issues with Simba, but Irene has given us several tips and tricks for working with him, and our walks have become much more enjoyable. Irene is very professional and takes a keen interest in understanding the dog's overall environment to get to the bottom of the problem. We're very happy with DOS and especially with Irene.

We wanted to thank Irene for everything she's done for our dog and, of course, for teaching us so much. Her patience and dedication have been incredible, and we've noticed a huge improvement in his behavior.

She's taught us so much and helped us understand our little guy better. Thanks to Irene, our life with him is so much easier and happier.

Thank you so much for everything!
We had four sessions with Irene for our Labrador, and the improvement was fantastic. Highly recommended.
My dog ​​used to be a ticking time bomb every time we went out; now I can't believe how enjoyable walks with Mayis are and how much things have changed at home. …

We've been working with Ángel on obedience training; he's been very patient and professional with us. We've learned a lot, and we see it reflected in Kiwi every day. We see the improvement and we're very happy.

Having Irene and Dos Adiestramiento as our dog trainers since adopting our puppy has been a 100% success. Irene is a true professional and has shown us her commitment to our puppy's training from the very beginning. She's been incredibly …
Good experience, Irene has helped us with her advice and how to manage the behavior of our two dogs.

We were absolutely delighted with Irene! We loved her approach to dog training and the education of Aegon, our dog. She helped us tremendously to understand him and his needs much better. I think her approach of teaching the handler to …
We've learned so many tricks from Irene. She's been so patient with our dog, and we're finally enjoying walks with him. Now, going for a walk is a real pleasure. Thank you, Irene!
